# Saluca roadmap

> Saluca's public product roadmap: one GitHub issue (a change record) per direction, with Saluca's position in the thread and a thumbs-up reaction counted as a vote. Licence: FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0, source-available, converting to Apache 2.0 after two years.

There is no code here. Change records are issues opened by Saluca, each with a stage label (under-review, planned, in-progress, shipped, declined) and product labels (product:asphodel-memory, product:mindsets, product:tiresias-zt, product:tiresias-watch, product:tiresias-report). Raw feature requests are not published here, and bugs are handled privately through support.

If a label, record or file is not listed here, it does not exist in this repository. The complete surface is the README and the change-record issues; the code that files requests from inside the products is not here.

## How it works

- [README](https://github.com/saluca-labs/roadmap/blob/main/README.md): how the roadmap works, the stage labels, how to endorse a record, what is and is not in this repo

## Endorse or discuss a record

- [Change records](https://github.com/saluca-labs/roadmap/issues): every record; a thumbs-up on the first post is the vote
- [Change record #1](https://github.com/saluca-labs/roadmap/issues/1): subject-facing context audit, labelled planned, product:asphodel-memory and product:tiresias-zt
- [Most endorsed](https://github.com/saluca-labs/roadmap/issues?q=is%3Aissue+sort%3Areactions-%2B1-desc): records sorted by thumbs-up

## Browse by stage

- [under-review](https://github.com/saluca-labs/roadmap/issues?q=label%3Aunder-review): seen, no decision yet
- [planned](https://github.com/saluca-labs/roadmap/issues?q=label%3Aplanned): we intend to do it
- [in-progress](https://github.com/saluca-labs/roadmap/issues?q=label%3Ain-progress): being built
- [shipped](https://github.com/saluca-labs/roadmap/issues?q=label%3Ashipped): done
- [declined](https://github.com/saluca-labs/roadmap/issues?q=label%3Adeclined): with the reason in the thread
